notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h3]"We have implemented a new update to celebrate the inclusion of HoloIndie."  

"Additionally, we will continue to release updates to address balancing, graphics, bug fixes, and translation errors until Thursday, the 23rd. Please share your feedback in the discussion threads so we can further improve the game. Thank you."[/h3]  

[list]  
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]  

[list]  
[*] Fixed an issue where boss monsters would occasionally stop moving immediately when pushed by Death Sensei.  
[/list]  

[h1]Major Update[/h1] 

[list]  

[h3]"The two units being added this time are classified as 'Unique Units.' They cannot be purchased from the shop and can only be unlocked at a low probability through random boxes. Their drop rates are the same as those for unique artifacts."[/h3]  

[h2]New Unit: 'Tokino Sora' Added[/h2]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/2f06efc70a022bb87ccf5676d2cdf2aedf23b2bf.gif[/img]  

[list]  
[*] The new unit, Tokino Sora, has been added. Sora is a Supporter unit, but unlike other supporters, she is specialized in enhancing a single unit.  

[*] [b]Can only be unlocked at a low probability through random boxes.[/b]  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[list]  

[h2]New Unit: 'Sakura Miko' Added[/h2]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/6a3e237b520d754e411ff7e10ecc41d61b2fdf1d.gif[/img]

[list]  
[*] The new unit, Sakura Miko, has been added. Miko is a Projectile unit who uses fortune papers to either support allied units or deal damage to enemies.  

[*] [b]Can only be unlocked at a low probability through random boxes.[/b]  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[list]  
[h2]Other Adjustments[/h2]  

[list]  
[*] Interface design has been slightly adjusted.  
[*] Fixed translation errors in the English guide text.  
[*] HOLOMONEY acquisition rates have been nerfed.  
[list]  

[*] The HOLOMONEY drop rate from random boxes has been nerfed.  
[*] When the same item appears in a random box, the HOLOMONEY refund rate has been reduced from 40% -> 30%.  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[h1]Balancing[/h1]  

[list]  
[*][h2]Units[/h2]  

[list]  
[*] [h3]Usada Pekora[/h3]  

[list]  
[*] The buff effect multiplier for the "Big Carrot Explosion" pattern has been buffed from 30% -> 40%.  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[list]  
[*] [h3]Mori Calliope[/h3]  

[list]  
[*] 'Soul' drop rate has been reduced from 25% -> 5%.  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[list]  
[*] [h3]Amane Kanata[/h3]  

[list]  
[*] The damage multiplier of the 'Fastball at 500km/h' pattern has been increased from 150% -> 200%.  
[*] The damage per stack of the 'Fastball at 500km/h' pattern has been increased from 4 -> 6.  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[list]  
[*] [h3]Himemori Luna[/h3]  

[list]  
[*] When the "Luna Time" pattern is activated, the buff effect multiplier received by units other than Luna has been buffed from 30% -> 50%.  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[list]  
[*] [h3]Nanashi Mumei[/h3]  

[list]  
[*] The damage multiplier for the "Feather Explosion" pattern has been nerfed from 200% -> 150%.  
[*] The damage multiplier increase for "Feather Explosion" from the "Feather FLOWER" pattern has been nerfed from 300% -> 250%.  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[list]  
[*] [h3]Ceres Fauna[/h3]  

[list]  
[*] The attack speed boost rate from the 'Rapid Growth' pattern has been reduced from 80% -> 70%.  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.0 (Full Release)
notes.content:
[h3]The Early Access period will end with version 0.12.3, and the full release version (1.0.0) will be updated. After the full release, content additions, balancing, and bug fixes will continue until December 14th.[/h3]

[list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the description window for 'Amane Kanata' unit and 'Mori Calliope' were swapped in the collection.
[*] Fixed a stat error where 'Kobo Kanaeru' unit's HP regeneration was set to 0.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]

[h3]Since the monster power values have increased, the stats for all units have been globally buffed.[/h3]

[list]
[*][h2]Units[/h2]

[list]
[*] [h3]Houshou Marine[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 60 -> 80.
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.1 -> 0.12.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Usada Pekora[/h3]

[i]"We found that many users playing Pekora did not place additional units within the explosion range of the Big Carrot. The starting units were designed to be simple, but the original Big Carrot explosion mechanic seemed a bit inconvenient to use, so we made this change."[/i]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 50 -> 70.
[*] hp_inc nerfed from 0.2 -> 0.17.
[*] 'Big Carrot Explosion' now affects all units, regardless of range, rather than just units within the explosion range.
[*] 'Big Carrot Explosion' buff effects (POWER, SPEED, HP) nerfed from 70% -> 30%.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Shiranui Flare[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 60 -> 65.
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.15 -> 0.17.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Shirogane Noel[/h3]

[i]"Noel, being the only tank unit in the game, has a significant advantage in early HP values. However, as the game progresses, other range-attack units have similar HP growth, which diminishes Noel's role. We decided to increase her hp_inc value to make her stand out more from other range-attacker units."[/i]

[list]
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.02 -> 0.1.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Gawr Gura[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 110 -> 120.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Inugami Korone[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 90 -> 100.
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.1 -> 0.12.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Tsunomaki Watame[/h3]

[i]"Watame performs excellently in line clearing during the early game with her sheep and slow effects, but her performance significantly drops in the later stages. We determined that buffing the sheep’s HP would not cause any balance issues, so we have significantly increased the sheep's HP for now. If necessary, we are also considering making the sheep's HP grow alongside Watame's level progression."[/i]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 60 -> 80.
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.1 -> 0.12.
[*] POWER buffed from 10 -> 12.
[*] Sheep's HP buffed from 450 -> 800.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Oozora Subaru[/h3]

[i]"Subaru was previously a unit with a pulling force, making it awkward to use both in monster stages and boss battles. 
Subaru was the first unit where the pushing force concept was introduced. At the time, we thought pushing force would have a significant advantage, so we added pulling force as an additional feature to introduce a risk. 
However, we now believe that pushing force doesn't need to come with such a significant risk in the current game, so we have decided to remove the pulling force. If Subaru is later considered too powerful, the pulling force may be reintroduced."[/i]

[list]
[*] Removed the pull force from the base pattern.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Watson Amelia[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 55 -> 60.
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.17 -> 0.2.
[*] POWER buffed from 8 -> 10.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Mori Calliope[/h3]

[i]"We have observed that many users have been experiencing discomfort with Calliope's design. The previous Calliope had the advantage of being able to permanently increase her power value throughout the game, so we believed that there should be a corresponding risk to obtain this. As a result, we lowered Calliope's HP overall and made it so that she must collect souls directly, adding a risk to acquiring them. However, this approach ultimately caused significant discomfort when playing Calliope, and naturally led to players avoiding collecting souls during gameplay.

Therefore, we have changed the soul collection to an automatic harvest system and altered the mechanics of Death Sense, aiming to eliminate any discomfort while playing Calliope. However, Calliope's HP is still set lower than other range-attacker units to maintain the risk of having to be cautious about monster patterns."[/i]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 65 -> 75.
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.13 -> 0.15.
[*] Souls are now automatically collected, eliminating the need to manually pick them up.
[*] Death Sensei is now an object, not a unit.
[list]

[*] Death Sensei now launches a projectile dealing 200% damage and disappears.
[*] Death Sensei is summoned at Calliope's position, not in front of her.
[*] Death Sensei's push force increased from 3 -> 4 on first appearance.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Amane Kanata[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 105 -> 110.
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.13 -> 0.16.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Himemori Luna[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 55 -> 80.
[*] The buff effects (POWER, SPEED, HP) given to units other than Luna when they collect Magic Candy are nerfed from 70% -> 30%.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Shirakami Fubuki[/h3]

[list]
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.11 -> 0.125.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Tokoyami Towa[/h3]

[list]
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.1 -> 0.16.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Nanashi Mumei[/h3]

[i]"We found that Mumei's power value without the 'Power of Bonds' buff was too low, making her too reliant on it. Therefore, we significantly increased her base POWER."[/i]

[list]
[*] hp_inc buffed from 0.09 -> 0.18.
[*] POWER buffed from 5 -> 10.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Yukihana Lamy[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 100 -> 110.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Hoshimachi Suisei[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 90 -> 95.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Ceres Fauna[/h3]

[i]"Unlike other supporter units, Fauna needs to be positioned with other units, so we decided to increase her base HP to ensure she can tank effectively."[/i]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 60 -> 100.
[*] hp_inc nerfed from 0.21 -> 0.11.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Kureiji Ollie[/h3]

[i]"Ollie shares the same range as Gura but had a lower POWER value. However, we found that her overall damage output was significantly lower than Gura's, so we decided to buff her POWER."[/i]

[list]
[*] POWER buffed from 6 -> 10.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Kobo Kanaeru[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP buffed from 50 -> 65.
[*] POWER buffed from 8 -> 10.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Artifacts[/h2]

[h3][i]"In the 0.10.5 update, the HP values of artifacts were significantly nerfed. However, due to a calculation error at the time, we couldn't properly calculate the exact values. Therefore, we've re-adjusted the HP values across the board. Additionally, some common artifacts were increasing HP more than rare and unique artifacts, which was unintended, so we've also fixed that."[/i][/h3]

[list]
[*] [h3]Pokobe's leaf[/h3]
  [list]

  [*] HP increase value has been nerfed from 30 to 3.
  [/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Tsukune's Hair[/h3]
  [list]

  [*] HP increase value has been nerfed from 50 to 6.
  [/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]MikoP's Underpants[/h3]
  [list]

  [*] HP increase value has been buffed from 5% to 8%.
  [/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Sora's hairpin[/h3]
  [list]

  [*] HP increase value has been buffed from 6% to 12%.
  [/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Koyori's poison[/h3]
  [list]

  [*] HP increase value has been buffed from 10% to 15%.
  [/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Laplus's Tail Core[/h3]
  [list]

  [*] HP increase value has been buffed from 20% to 25%.
  [/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Coco's Fossil Footprint[/h3]
  [list]

  [*] HP increase value has been buffed from 20% to 40%.
  [/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Bijou's Gem[/h3]
  [list]

  [*] HP increase value has been buffed from 10% to 25%.
  [/list]
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The effect is now displayed on the unit capable of levelling up.
[*] Added background behind the speed button for visibility.
[*] The design of the result screen background has been slightly updated.
[*] Adjusted the size of some interfaces.
[*] The retry button is deleted.
[/list]

notes.title: Plans for the Remainder of the Year
notes.content:
Hello, this is runinzem, in charge of planning and art. In this notice, I would like to talk about the future direction of our game development.

First, I'd like to inform you of some changes to the existing update schedule. Previously, updates were carried out on a bi-monthly basis, but moving forward, Holosaga will shift to a [b]non-regular update schedule.[/b]

There are several reasons for this change. The first reason is to allow more flexibility in our development timeline, enabling us to provide more stable updates. Our previous schedule was somewhat tight given the development resources available, making it difficult to thoroughly test updates due to the overlap between the update day and the deadline.
The second reason is to prioritize high-importance updates. Currently, there are many aspects of Holosaga that are inconvenient for users, such as the interface and controls. We determined that it would be better to divide the updates into smaller parts to focus first on these improvements.

As a result, future updates will be released irregularly, and the update plans will be announced not on a monthly basis but right before the update is released.

In this notice, we will explain the updates we are currently planning.

[h2]Switching Function Rework[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/27a03a56f7e69a32c6527e257b4817c93db7420a.png[/img]

Many of you have expressed that the switching function is inconvenient. Since switching is a core feature of this game that is used frequently, we believe that improving its usability should be our top priority.

The biggest reason why this function feels inconvenient seems to be the drag-and-drop mechanism.

Given that the gameplay involves continuous unit movement in real time, especially for PC users, the drag-and-drop method has proven to be a significant design flaw. The tiles are quite small, making it difficult to accurately click on a unit and hold that click. It is understandable that many users find this inconvenient. Therefore, we plan to change the switching method from drag-and-drop to simple clicking. After this update, you will no longer need to drag to switch units; instead, you will be able to relocate them by simply clicking on the unit and then on the desired tile.

Another issue that was pointed out regarding the switching function was the ON/OFF feature. Since switching is essential in this game, players always had to keep the function ON to play, which caused the top interface to overlap with the units, making it difficult to see important information like health, and the grid made the map look cluttered. To address this, we plan to make the switching function always active and remove the grid images that were provided previously. Instead, we will include grid markers within each map to prevent clutter.

We aim to implement the overhaul of the switching function as soon as it is ready. If there are other aspects of switching that you find inconvenient, please let us know, and we will continue to make improvements to the usability of the switching function.

[h2]In-Game Interface Improvements[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/b17eb8cfe25ae46aca3e5abc492793d15d967324.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/f80720af211aa9518a525624927803a9f789c258.png[/img]

The current unit profile information is difficult to see. The information is generally too small, and important details that should stand out are not properly visible due to poor layout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/9b899b79d11d62e025802436c3d7c723962ad29b.png[/img]

We are currently exploring various design concepts to address these issues.

In the design above, we’ve placed information that doesn’t need to be checked in real time, such as level, upgrades, and artifacts, towards the top, while information that needs to be monitored constantly, like HP, current experience points, and POWER, is placed at the bottom.

Additionally, we’ve added an “over-spec level” indicator to the profile design to more intuitively show how powerful a unit has become.

This design is just one of our interface concepts, and we will continue to test various designs to implement the best possible update.

[h2]New Unit Additions[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/e325f8136e60dac25719eeb88fc05ba605408a1b.png[/img]

Among the units we are planning to add in future updates, we would like to introduce three units: Nanashi Mumei, Tokoyami Towa, and Yukihana Lamy.

Nanashi Mumei is being designed as a projectile unit with the concepts of “stacking” and “radial attack.” As she attacks enemies, she accumulates stacks, and once a certain number of stacks is reached, she will deal additional damage with a radial attack, making her a versatile unit that excels in both single-target and line-clearing attacks.

Tokoyami Towa is also a projectile unit, specializing in line-clearing with her “penetrating attack.” She can pull enemies from other lines to a specific point, and although her attack speed is slow, she deals powerful damage.

Yukihana Lamy is a Range-Attacker unit with a basic pattern that continuously deals damage to enemies in her vicinity. Since she needs to be placed deep within enemy lines to be effective, she will also have strong survival abilities.

We are currently designing many more units, and once development is complete, we will thoroughly test them before releasing updates.

[h2]New Mode Addition[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/c90444c61b81a2de2e9e6f9b6fbf1df98b7748de.png[/img]

In addition to the Standard and Infinite modes, we plan to add a “Single Mode.” In Single Mode, you select one unit, and that unit will be deployed four times for the game. The stage progression will be the same as in Standard Mode, and this mode is intended to feel more like a sub-content rather than a main content.

[h2]Speed-Up Feature Addition[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/dddf37a8f4d171aa1579920103847dcbb15d53a1.png[/img]

Many users have suggested adding a speed-up feature.

We are currently considering this feature carefully. Since this game is a defense game, there aren’t as many actions to take compared to other games, which can make the game feel slow-paced. However, we are concerned that a speed-up feature might accelerate content consumption too quickly and make controls like switching and leveling up too difficult.

As this is an issue that requires careful consideration, if we determine that it can be added without major issues, we will review the potential problems again and proceed with the update.

notes.title: future update plan (August)
notes.content:
Hello, this is runinzem, in charge for art and game design for this game. I would like to share our update plans for August.

This month, we have two updates scheduled: August 17 (v0.7.0) and August 31 (v0.8.0). The focus of these updates will be on adding new content and new methods for power-ups.

[h2]Update 0.7.0 (Scheduled for 2024-08-17)[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new system, "Artifacts," will be introduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/f946b2d25b9a09905382f010648ca80df2937725.png[/img]
(This is concept art; some details may change in the actual game update.)

Artifacts are equipment items that can be equipped by units. They can be obtained from monster drops or purchased with Artifact Fragments. Equipping artifacts will grant your units special abilities and additional stats. Units equipped with fitting artifacts will be able to perform much more powerfully than before.
Artifacts come in various rarities, including "Common," "Epic," and "Unique." Only the Common and Epic grades will be released initially.

[*] A new difficulty level, "EXTREME," will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/dcaa2e285cb67bd7e6cc0218cc3b323ab6949905.png[/img]
(This is concept art; some details may change in the actual game update.)

The "EXTREME" difficulty will feature even stronger monsters than the current HARD mode, along with a new "Disaster" system. Disasters are randomly assigned each game and will make gameplay more varied challenges and gameplay variables.
[/list]

[h2]Update 0.8.0 (Scheduled for 2024-08-31)[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new unit, "Shirakami Fubuki," will be added.

Fubuki is an nuking range-attacker unit capable of dealing massive damage over a short period. She can enter "Transformation Mode" using a gauge that builds up over time, and in this transformed state, she will deal even greater damage. However, if the gauge is mismanaged, there will be associated risks.

[*] A new content, "Infinite Mode," will be introduced.

Unlike the regular mode, which ends at Stage 5, "Infinite Mode" will allow you to play through endless stages. Players will have the opportunity to choose from various ability cards for their units at specific intervals, and the goal is to survive as many rounds as possible against the endless waves of enemies.
[/list]

[*] [i]"The new system 'Overspec' has been added. Units that have completed all upgrades can undergo additional stat upgrades through Overspec."[/i]

[list]
[*] Once a unit reaches upgrade level 3, Overspec unlocks.
[*] In Overspec, four stats can be increased: HP, POWER, HP INC, and POWER INC. Each stat has the following functions:

[list]
[*] HP - Unit's level 1 health
[*] POWER - Unit's level 1 attack power
[*] HP INC - Unit's HP growth factor upon leveling up (Each time the unit levels up, sum calculation is performed in proportion to this value)
[*] POWER INC - Unit's POWER growth factor upon leveling up (Each time the unit levels up, sum calculation is performed in proportion to this value)
[/list]
[*] HP and POWER can be increased by 25% per stage, up to a total of 100%, while HP INC and POWER INC can be increased by 5% per stage, up to a total of 25%.

[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

[/list]
[/list]
[list]

[*] Icons indicating the type of pattern have been added to the shop upgrade window.
[*] A help button has been added to the shop upgrade window.
[*] The 'Field' category has been removed from the shop.
[*] Sound effects have been added to Flare's basic pattern.
[*] The draw order of Lui's Pattern 4 VFX has been adjusted.
[*] Flare's idle motion has been slightly adjusted.
[*] The animation length of Flare's 'Fire Breath' pattern VFX has been adjusted to match the casting time.
[*] The tooltip error for Flare's 'Fire Breath' pattern has been corrected (Flame Move -> Fire Breath).
[*] Subaru's modeling has been slightly modified.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[/list]
[h1]Balancing[/h1]

[list]
[*][h2]Units[/h2]

[list]
[*] [h3]Shirogane Noel[/h3]

[list]
[*] POWER has been changed from 15 -> 20.
[*] POWER INC has been changed from 0.8 -> 0.48.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[*] Fixed a bug where the next round countdown would proceed during the Laplus boss fight.
[*] Fixed a bug where some bosses' collection didn't open even after reaching the boss stage.

notes.title: future update plan (June)
notes.content:
Hello, I'm runinzem, in charge of game design and art for this game. Once again, I'd like to share our future update plans.

Just like last month, updates are scheduled every other week this month as well. This upcoming update will focus on adding content such as adding final stages and expanding rewards rather than adding new units.

Before introducing our update plans, I'd like to address the user feedback and our improvements from the last patch. The following three points will be directly implemented in the 0.2.4 update before the 0.3.0 update:


[h2]Game Freezing Issue[/h2]

In the upcoming 0.2.4 patch, code structural improvement will be implemented.

The game is currently experiencing continuous freezes for reasons unknown. As a result, a2no, who is in charge of the programming, has conducted a comprehensive review of the code and proceeded with structural improvements.

However, it's important to note that since the root cause has not been definitively identified yet, there is a possibility that the game may continue to freeze even after the update. Therefore, we use the term "structural improvement" rather than confirming a complete fix. We appreciate your active reporting if the same bug persists after the 0.2.4 update.


[h2]Rollback of Level-Up System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/5d1da4c4df8191477422c1391310fa6af1a642bf.png[/img]

In the upcoming 0.2.4 patch, along with code structure improvements, the level-up system will be rolled back to its previous state. [b]Furthermore, the Holomoney used for leveling up so far will be refunded (increased level X 100 for all units).[/b]

In the initial stages of game development, the current upgrade system was actually not based on upgrading through Holomoney but rather on a mechanism where upgrades were automatically applied at specific intervals when leveling up in-game. However, planning in this manner would prevent players from fully enjoying units at their maximum upgrade level, and since it made clearing the game too easy by simply owning all units, I redesigned the upgrade system to its current format.

The recent overhaul of the level-up system was also carried out in the same context. I deemed it unbalanced for characters to fully recover all their HP immediately upon leveling up, and considering that unit stats are more critical for clearing, we concluded that it was structurally problematic for players to easily clear hard difficulty without upgrading units. Therefore, we proceeded with the overhaul.

However, this decision resulted in a significant deviation from the game's direction. Players are now unable to progress through previously completed stages without earning money for leveling up, and the decrease in stats has significantly slowed down the rate at which monsters are killed, leading to increased boredom due to reduced in-game functionality. Even if there were structural issues with the level-up system, the complete overhaul that blocked players from doing what they could originally do was clearly a wrong decision.

As a result, in this 0.2.4 patch, we decided to roll back only the level up system as before. The system being rolled back is exactly the same as before, so you can enjoy the same style of play as before again.


[h2] Accelerate the pace of the stage. [/h2]

This 0.2.4 patch accelerates the progress of the stage. The latency of the break stage is reduced, and monsters appear faster. First of all, we will check the reactions of the users, and if this improvement gets a positive response, we will further reduce the stage round.


Now let me give you a brief plan for the upcoming update 0.3.0 (scheduled 2024-06-22), 0.4.0 (scheduled 2024-07-06). The content below is unconditionally reflected in the update if there is no other reason, and some more may be added.


[h2]Update 0.3.0 (2024-06-22) [/h2]

[list]
[*] A new unit 'Amane Kanata' will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/049571c23a4f4f6524423082a0dd5f00e8ed4c66.gif[/img]

 - Kanata is a melee range-attacker unit. The more you attack, the more you can stack, and you consume this stacks to give a powerful blow. The play method is to stack as much as you can on the normal stage, and consume the stacks you collected on the last boss stage, causing great damage.

notes.title: Update Schedule Postponed Notice and Introduction to the 0.2.0 Update
notes.content:
[b]The next update (0.2.0) schedule will be postponed to June 1st. [/b]

Hello, I'm Runinzem in charge of game design and art of this game. First of all, I'm very sorry to postpone the schedule. We've tried to update it as much as possible, but We couldn't meet the schedule because there were many changes from the original update.

Instead of omitting the "overSpack" system from what was originally intended to be updated, the 0.2.0 version will change the existing gameplay structure a lot. As the game system is very different from the previous one, I would like to introduce the system that will change to the users before the update.

The image shown below is still in the development stage, and I would like to inform you that some changes may occur after the update.


[h1]Permanentization of in-game level-up systems [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/e4f9009b3e5b504870b8bbc7f3bf75db89ad80bd.png[/img]

The system that used to "defeat monsters in in-game and level up by gaining experience" will be changed to a system, "permanently leveling the unit just like the upgrade."

The genre of this game is defense, and even if there isn't an EXP when you catch a monster, there are already reasons to catch a monster(because otherwise, you will be Gameover). Therefore, we judged that the EXP reward that users get from in-game is just extra from defending, and it's hard to give more meaning than that. Users also sent a lot of comments that the EXP value expressed in percentages is very confusing. 

As a result, we changed the level-up system that existed in the game to the growth method. Price needed for level-up will be increased according to the current level, and the stat you can gain for leveling will be the same as before.


[h1]Cost type Integrated[/h1]



UnitEXP will now be deleted from the costs (unitEXP, HOLOMONEY) that currently exist in the game.

In order to upgrade an existing unit, it was a method of accumulating a cost called unitEXP first and then upgrading using HOLOMONEY, but it was forced to play that unit to obtain unitEXP, which led to a situation where the upgrade could not be made even though there was enough HOLOMONEY. Accordingly, I thought that deleting unitEXP would provide more pleasant play.

In the future, all methods of strengthening the unit will be done through HOLOMONEY, and the cost of the upgrade will be the same as before.


[h1]Added unit role groups [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/c1d4625a4c90a646ffe23ae4b09f015b9610bf2a.png[/img]

The unit's role group (range attack, projection, supporter) is added.

Originally, the concept of role groups had been established since the beginning of development, but I thought it would be meaningless, so I thought it would be better not to provide the information on the UI. However, there was a problem that users had to check the pattern information one day to determine which unit the unit was when playing. Therefore, I decided that it would be better to also show information that only existed systematically on the role groups on the UI.

Here is a brief description of the role group -

[list]
[*] Range-Attacker - 'Default Pattern' attacks monsters within range 'all'.
[*] Projectile - 'Default pattern' fires the projectile. The number of monsters a projectile can attack varies from projectile to projectile. Projectile units always have a 'maximum range'.
[*] Supporter - 'Default pattern' doesn't have the ability to attack, but the ability to support units. 
[/list]

Among the units currently in existence, Noel, Gura and others belong to Range-Attacker units, while units like Marine, Watson and Watame belong to Projectile units. And Pekora belongs to Supporter units.


[h1]Added a pattern type [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/1170b002d16a0036abb51a2ebf5235898cf7c15c.png[/img]

A classification is added for patterns whose concepts were not previously clear.

With the addition of this classification, there will be some units with new patterns added altogether, but most of them will be changed not too different from traditional plays.

Patterns are largely divided into basic patterns, passive patterns, and active patterns.

[list]
[*] The Default pattern is a pattern that is unconditionally basic to the UPGRADE 1, which is the same as the concept of basic attack.
[*] Passive patterns add additional capabilities to the Default patterns, or change the play mechanism of the unit.
EX) Gura 'Sea explosion' Pattern, Noel 'Bash Attack' etc

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/3656b8090db19ff3ab6df088979a3d68ff86ae42.png[/img]
[*] The Active pattern is a new system introduced in this update, and it is a pattern that users use directly by pressing a button(Q,W,E,R). An active pattern can only have one unit in all units, and some units do not have an active pattern. During this update, the pattern of some units will be changed to an active pattern, and some units will have a new pattern added.
[/list]


[h1]Unit store, skin store reorganization [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/17e6215eb6696702f864d0ff8b3916621f08bd2d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/b5550738f02bf063ba7332628134b732e7252599.png[/img]

The unit store and skin store will be reorganized.

When an existing unit comes out from the gacha, there is a system that can get unitEXP for that unit, but with the disappearance of unitEXP, it is no longer possible to get any compensation. Accordingly, the existing unit Gacha system will be deleted and the unit will be able to be purchased directly as a single unit. In addition, categories will be added to classify units according to role groups.

In the case of skin stores, there is not much difference from before, but now a '*' button is added to collect and view skins of all units.


[h1]Mori calliope unit added [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973890/799c218d4b98fec38f13ae0595b37550b69b5275.png[/img]

A Calliope unit is added.

Instead of having a wide range of attacks, Calliope has a low attack speed. You can raise her POWER by killing monsters, and in the end, you'll be able to kill two birds with one stone - damage and wide range of attacks. Instead, her HP is lower than that of a normal Range-Attacker unit, so you have to pay extra attention to survival.


[h1]Game play improvement [/h1]


Overall improvements to gameplay will be made. I don't think it's going to be easy to say for sure exactly what improvements will be made on this. Currently, we have confirmed that many of the users have experienced unpleasant experiences such as blocking the progress of the game or lagging in between, so we are working on code modification and system improvement. We expect a lot of improvements to be made after the update.

notes.title: Future update plan (May)
notes.content:
[i]Prior to the explanation, since there are only two developers in our team, including myself, there is no one in charge of translation. So I'm writing the original text wrote in  Korean in a translator for all other languages and revising it. Therefore, please understand in advance that there may be mistranslation as the content of this article is long.[/i]

Hello, I'm runinzem in charge of game design and art in this game. We started our first early access on May 1st this year, and we found out from the experience of the users that there is still a lot of lack of content. 

In the future, major patches will be updated biweekly. Some patches that not to add contents, such as bug fixes, convenience patches will be mixed with major patches or uploaded regardless of the update schedule.

In May, we will try to do as many patches as possible to secure the convenience of our users. In addition, we will try to produce content that needs to be added as soon as possible until users can feel the complete play experience.

First of all, I would like to tell you first about the improvements we have thought about through the feedback of users.


[h2] UI Improvement [/h2]

 Most of the users have sent a lot of feedbacks that the guide does not exist and the UI is uncomfortable. As a result, we would like to reflect the feedback users gave to the update as early as this weekend.
 If the patch goes as planned, improvements in game guides and interface intuition, addition of screen magnification settings, and full screen capabilities will be reflected in upcoming patches as soon as possible.

[h2]The concept of the weapon and the pattern Flare uses. [/h2]

 First of all, I will tell you the planning intention of the Flare unit first. 

 Flare's weapon concept and pattern concept have been mostly inspired by hololive alternative. The scene where Flare fights Coco with a bow in the teaser video looked cool to me, so I used this concept to plan a unit.
 Flare initially planned to come out as a initial unit, so I decided that it would be better to have a simple design. so unlike Marine, I tried planned her to have strong benefit on the line clearing. Accordingly, I designed the projectile to a penetrating concept, and the more she upgraded, the more she can attack further range. so I decided to design it as a unit specialized in range attack, and I personally thought that the bow fits well as an attack weapon to implement it.
 However, I did not realize that the motif of the unit, Flare, had a disliked image of the bow, and we heard a lot of opinions from users about it. Even in our judgment, Flare's current design has many problems, and we have not studied enough about this in making fan games.
 [b]As a result, the Flare will be temporarily locked in version 0.1.0, which will be patched in the future, and will be redesigned with new patterns and concepts as soon as possible. [/b] The reason for the Flare lock in version 0.1.0 is to fill the unit gaps created by the Flare lockout with new units, and the Korone will be temporarily switched to the basic unit instead of the Flare. 
 Once again, I'm really sorry for designing Flare for the wrong direction.


Next, I would like to briefly explain the main updates we have planned in the future. I would like to say that it is difficult to give you the details as we are still in the planning stage.


[h2]Update 0.1.0 (scheduled by 2024-05-11)[/h2]

[list]
[*]New units 'Oozora Subaru' and 'Watson Amelia' will be updated.

 - Subaru has the concept of using yo-yo to push units in front of her to long distances. However, as it is a powerful ability, we will design her to be difficult to use when simply leaving her not to move.

 - Watson has a concept that gives units extra exp points. This ability will enable units to grow faster, and we expect users to be able to clear stages faster.

[*]New boss 'Takane Louie' will be added. 

 - As she is in charge of stage four, we will design it as a boss that is more difficult to avoid and has a wider range than previous bosses. The main keywords are magic, blood, and 'ganmo'.

[/list]

[h2]Update 0.2.0 (scheduled by 2024-05-25)[/h2]

[list]
[*]The new unit 'Mori Calliope' will be updated.

 - Calli will be able to perform wide area attacks using scythe and use additional specification-up ability. She can raise the stat just by killing monsters apart from level up.

[*]The 'Overspec' system will be included.

 - For stage 5 to be added, we thought that additional spec would be needed, so we planned a new system. We decided that it would be appropriate to introduce this system in the 0.2.0 update, for the sake of new content to be updated after all stages were added.

[*]Function changes are scheduled for 'Shop' and 'Collection'.

 - I received an opinion that it is inconvenient to upgrade units in the collection. Accordingly, when I looked back at the system once again, I noticed that there is an unfriendly design that requires to re-enter the store to see holomoney because the collection also has a system that requires holomoney, while info about it's amount only exists in the store. Accordingly, we are trying to re-establish the functions of the store and collection while introducing the over-spec system.

[/list]
